'''Tessek''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Quarren]] who was an [[accountant]] for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> as well as a patron of his, enjoying the decadent atmosphere of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] and frequenting parties there.<ref name="Card Trader">{{Topps|set=2017 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Reborn|cardname=ROTJ-15 - Tessek}}</ref> A clever individual with good financial skills,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Tessek approached his life in Jabba's employ with a highly calculating mind. He took advantage of his position as Jabba's bookkeeper to secretly embezzle [[Currency|money]] into his own accounts and plotted to assassinate his employer, aspiring to take over Jabba's vast [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]]. Jabba was aware of Tessek's schemes, which were revealed to him by one of the [[B'omarr Order|B'omarr monks]]. Prior to serving Jabba, he was involved in galactic politics. The Empire's enslavement of his people drove him into hiding on Tatooine.

==Biography==
===From politician to criminal accountant===
Tessek was a [[Quarren]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]] who was involved in [[The galaxy|galactic]] politics until the [[Galactic Empire]] began to [[Slavery|enslave]] his [[Species|people]]. This drove the Quarren into hiding on the [[desert]] planet [[Tatooine]], where he put his financial skills to use for the [[Hutt]] [[gangster]]s there, becoming employed as an [[accountant]] at the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Behind his employer's back,<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> Tessek embezzled funds from Jabba into a secret account,<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> diverting money from the Hutt's many enterprises.<ref name="HothEncyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star}}</ref> He plotted to [[Death|kill]] the crime lord and take over [[Jabba's criminal empire|his criminal empire]];<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> however, unbeknownst to the Quarren, Jabba had been informed of Tessek's plan by one of the [[B'omarr Order|B'omarr monks]] with whom the Hutt secretly conferred.<ref name="CVD" />

[[File:VaderInJabbasPalace-2015DarthVader1.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Tessek was dismissed from Jabba the Hutt's throne room during a visit from Darth Vader.]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Galaxy's Edge Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashback events of [[Galaxy's Edge 2|''Galaxy's Edge'' 2]] to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Tessek was part of the crowd in the Jabba's [[throne]] room when the [[Rodian]] [[Greedo]] returned from an unsuccessful [[Mission to Mygeeto|mission]] to the planet [[Mygeeto]]. Greedo presented the [[Ki-Adi-Mundi's lightsaber|lightsaber]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] as tribute to Jabba, which the [[Ithorian]] [[Dok-Ondar]] immediately offered to buy from Jabba. This caused Jabba to show leniency and spare Greedo rather than dropping the Rodian into the pit below the throne room where the crime lord kept his pet [[rancor]],<ref name="GE2">[[Galaxy's Edge 2|''Galaxy's Edge'' 2]]</ref> [[Pateesa]].<ref name="LD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">{{BountyHuntDate}}</ref> Tessek stood with<ref name="Bounty Hunt">''[[Bounty Hunt]]''</ref> the [[Askajian]] dancer [[Yarna d'al' Gargan]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> in Jabba's throne room when the Hutt dropped an [[RA-7 protocol droid]] through a trap door into the rancor pit below the room.<ref name="Bounty Hunt" /> In [[0 ABY]],<ref name="DarthVaderDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]] to [[0 ABY]].</ref> Tessek was again in the throne room when the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] arrived and requested the services of [[bounty hunter]]s in Jabba's employ. The Hutt dismissed Tessek and the other court members present before negotiating with the [[Sith]].<ref name="V1">[[Darth Vader (2015) 1|''Darth Vader'' (2015) 1]]</ref>

===Not worth dying for===
{{Quote|You know who I am. ''Boba Fett''. You know what that means. All of you want to live. Who doesn't? But I promise. Fight me… some of you die. Maybe ''most'' of you. And you'd be dying… for ''him''. Doesn't seem fair, does it?|Boba Fett speaks to Tessek and others about risking their lives for Bib Fortuna|<ref name="WotBH 1">[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:BobaVsFortuna-WOTBH1.png|thumb|right|300px|Tessek confronted Fett at the palace, but ultimately backed down.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> [[Han Solo]], a [[smuggler]] affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], was frozen in [[carbonite]]. The bounty hunter [[Boba Fett]] was tasked with delivering the frozen Solo to Jabba, who had placed a [[bounty]] on Solo's head. However, Fett failed in this task when the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate stole Solo from him, and so Jabba placed a bounty on Fett as well. Hoping to confront Jabba, Fett traveled to Jabba's Palace, where he passed Tessek and<ref name="WotBH 1" /> Jabba's [[Buboicullaar|pet]] minder [[Ree-Yees]],<ref name="HothEncyclopedia" /> walking together as he approached the palace.<ref name="WotBH 1" />

Fett was greeted at the palace's entrance by Jabba's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]], who explained the Hutt was not on Tatooine as he was attending the Crimson Dawn's [[Auction for Han Solo|auction for Solo]]. The majordomo suggested the bounty hunter leave as a crowd, including Tessek and Ree-Yees, emerged behind him with their weapons aimed at the bounty hunter. Fett instead told the crowd that if they faced him then there was a chance they would die, and only for the sake of Fortuna. Silently, Tessek and the others in the crowd lowered their weapons and allowed Fett to enter the palace with Fortuna in order to see the invitation.<ref name="WotBH 1" />

===The problem with Solo===
[[File:ChewieImaginationBattle-2020StarWars22.png|thumb|left|300px|Chewbacca imagined encountering Tessek during his planned assault on Jabba's Palace.]]
Solo was eventually delivered to Jabba and put on display in his throne room, still frozen in carbonite.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The smuggler's co-[[pilot]], the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], began using a training space and [[Marksman-H training remote|remotes]] on the Rebel Alliance [[flagship]], ''[[Home One]]'', to plan a rescue for Solo and visualized fighting his way through Jabba's cronies as well as various bounty hunters. Tessek was among those he imagined encountering during a session of planning that was interrupted by the arrival of [[Qi'ra]], head of the Crimson Dawn.<ref name="SW22">[[Star Wars (2020) 22|''Star Wars'' (2020) 22]]</ref>

Later in 3 ABY,<ref name="Date">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> Tessek was present in the [[Pyke Cardroom (Mirogana)|Pyke Cardroom]], a gambling parlor that operated in the city [[Mirogana]] on the planet [[Toshara]], with fellow gamblers [[Gabish]] and [[Setauh]].{{Gamemechanics|Star Wars Outlaws|Canon=1}}The same year, the thief [[Kay Vess]] won a game of [[Kessel Sabacc]] against Tessek, Gabish, and Setauh in the Cardroom.<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>{{Endgame}}

In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="ROTJDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Tessek stood with Fett in Jabba's throne room when the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]] played a [[hologram]] of their master, [[Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker]], for Jabba. In the message, Skywalker asked to bargain for Solo's freedom. The Jedi gifted the two droids to Jabba as a sign of good will, but the Hutt revealed he had no intention of negotiating, as he enjoyed the frozen Solo on the throne room's wall.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

===A performance to die for===
Tessek later sat against a column in one of the throne room's booths during a performance of the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. When the band finished, Jabba ordered them to play the same song again, and they obliged. However, during the performance, Jabba tried to pull the enslaved dancer [[Oola]] closer to him, but she resisted his advances. This caused the Hutt to activate the throne room's trap door, dropping the dancer into the pit beneath his throne room. The music instantly stopped, and Tessek and other members of the court rushed forward to watch Oola's fate through a grate in the throne-room floor. As the courtiers cheered and waved, Pateesa devoured the screaming dancer.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

The court's attention was diverted by the sounds of [[blaster]] fire from the entryway to the throne room. Tessek and several others moved toward the noise, but stopped when [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] entered the room disguised as the bounty hunter [[Boushh]] with Chewbacca as her [[prisoner]]. Tessek backed out of the way as Organa made her way to stand before Jabba, who was glad to see Chewbacca brought low before him and offered the promised twenty-five-thousand-[[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] bounty on the Wookiee. Organa demanded double that, and produced an active [[thermal detonator]] as incentive. Tessek fled for cover, as did many other court members, but Jabba simply laughed and counteroffered thirty-five thousand credits, which Organa accepted. As Chewbacca was taken away to the palace dungeons, Tessek and the other court members cautiously emerged from cover, and the band soon resumed playing.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

===Spending time with Gargan===
[[File:GarganTessek-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Tessek spent time with Yarna d'al' Gargan at Jabba's Palace.]]
Organa's true objective in the palace was [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescuing Solo]], and later that night she crept back into the throne room while she believed the court was sleeping. Tessek was instead hiding behind curtains waiting to ambush Organa, as Jabba had seen through her disguise. They allowed her to free Solo from the carbonite, but once Organa had removed her mask, Jabba revealed his trap, and both Organa and Solo were captured.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> The court celebrated their new prisoners late into the night.<ref name="Darkside">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref>

The next morning, much of the court was sleeping off the night of partying,<ref name="Darkside" /> and Tessek slept with Gargan's head on his shoulder in one of the throne room's booths. While Jabba also slumbered, Skywalker arrived at the palace and [[mind trick]]ed Fortuna in to bringing him to Jabba and waking the crime lord. Tessek and the other members of the court also awoke as Skywalker demanded that Jabba release Solo and Chewbacca, and the Quarren stood with Gargan as Jabba refused the Jedi's request. Skywalker then threatened Jabba with a [[DL-18 blaster pistol|blaster pistol]], causing the Hutt to drop the Jedi into the rancor pit, along with the unlucky [[Gamorrean]] [[Security guard|guard]] [[Jubnuk]]. The court eagerly gathered around the grating to watch another execution, but after Pateesa ate Jubnuk, the Jedi killed the rancor.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

===Journey to Carkoon===
[[File:Tessek-Reeyees-Tiel-SailBarge-ROTJ.png|thumb|right|300px|Tessek traveled to the Great Pit of Carkoon on board the ''Khetanna''.]]
Tessek still stood with Gargan when the outraged Jabba had Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca brought before him and sentenced the trio to be fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelt in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The pair joined the crowd that followed the three prisoners as they were marched from the throne room.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Tessek was then forced to accompany the Hutt on his [[sail barge]], the ''[[Khetanna]]'',<ref name="HothEncyclopedia" /> in order to view the executions. During the journey, Tessek danced beside the [[musician]] [[Maximilian Rebo|Max Rebo]] as he played his [[red ball jett organ]]. Upon reaching the pit, Tessek stood beside Jabba as the Hutt gave the prisoners one last chance to beg for their lives, then moved closer to the barge's shutters and laughed when Skywalker warned Jabba to release him and his allies or die.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

Things took a turn after Jabba ordered that Skywalker be put over the edge of the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] into the sarlacc below, as the Jedi leapt back aboard, now armed with [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|his lightsaber]], which R2-D2 had launched to him. The Jedi began cutting down the guards around him as panic ensued on board the barge, which only became worse when Organa smashed the control panel that operated the hold's shutters and plunged all on board into darkness. Tessek and the other court members ran around in blind panic as Organa strangled Jabba with her own chain, killing the Hutt before escaping onto the top deck.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> Following Jabba's death, Tessek escaped the sail barge.<ref name="HothEncyclopedia" /> At the top deck, Organa met up with Skywalker and fired the barge's [[Me/7 double laser cannon|deck cannon]] down into the vehicle before safely exiting with the Jedi as the barge exploded.<ref name="Return of the Jedi" />

==Personality and traits==
Tessek was a financially skilled<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> and clever Quarren, who viewed the world of Jabba's palace with a clear and calculating mind.<ref name="CVD" /> His loyalty to Jabba was a smokescreen to hide his desire to kill the Hutt, although the Quarren did not realize that Jabba probably knew of his schemes.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> The Quarren was, however, guilt-ridden over embezzling from his employer and so was desperate to escape.<ref name="HothEncyclopedia" /> He lived up to some of the worst qualities attributed to Quarren by others, who often viewed the species as untrustworthy schemers willing to take any advantage. The accountant stood 1.8 [[meter]]s (5 [[foot]], 11 inches) tall and had [[Color|orange]] skin and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />

==Equipment==
Tessek wore white [[Water|moisture]]-retaining [[Clothing|robes]] with a white-lined gray [[Cape|cloak]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> He also wore a [[bronze]]-colored [[vand belt]], gray [[gauntlet]]s, and black shoes.<ref name="CVD" /> He carried a [[blaster pistol]] and a [[polearm]].<ref name="WotBH 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tessek first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Return of the Jedi" /> In costume, the character stood 183 centimeters tall and was nicknamed "Squid Head" by designer [[Chris Walas]],<ref name="Chronicles" /> although it was also known as "Squid Face" or "Squiddy" on set.<ref name="Nicknames">{{Rebelscum|subdomain=forum|url=threads/rotj-history-gerald-homes-creature-info.1069050/page-2#post-18520637|text=ROTJ History: Gerald Home's Creature Info.|author=[[Gerald Home|Home, Gerald]]|date=2011-07-03|archivedate=20211201101221}}</ref> Maquettes of the creature's head and hands were created for the film,<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> and epoxy was used on areas of the final mask to make it look wet.<ref name="Archeology">{{YouTube|video=RWw8-s_a0vM|text=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi - Cantina Archeology Part 3: Behind The Scenes of Jabba's Palace|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref>

Tessek was portrayed by [[Gerald Home]], one of nine mime artists who worked on the film. Originally the characters portrayed by the mime artists were supposed to have far more prominent roles in the palace, but due to the number of extras present, there ended up being no time or space for a lot of what they had intended to do. This meant that a lot of material that Home rehearsed with [[Claire Davenport]], who portrayed Yarna d'al' Gargan, did not get used.

While on set, Home's glass would sometimes steam up, worrying him about falling through the hole in the set that represented the rancor pit.<ref name="HomeInterview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsy.pl/opowiadania/wywiad_home_eng.htm|text=Quarren with the misted glasses. The interview with Gerald Home.|author=Turkiewicz, Kuba|archivedate=20160303172049}}</ref> Home acted drunk as Tessek while on the sail barge set, although this did not make it into the film.<ref name="Drunk">{{Rebelscum|subdomain=forum|url=threads/rotj-history-gerald-homes-creature-info.1069050/page-2#post-18522480|text=ROTJ History: Gerald Home's Creature Info.|author=[[Gerald Home|Home, Gerald]]|date=2011-07-05|archivedate=20220618113713}}</ref>

In the new Star Wars [[canon]], Tessek was first identified by name in the [[2015]] book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' published by [[Dorling Kindersley|Dorsling Kindersley]].<ref name="Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref>
